text: Visit 3/2026. 58M here for BP f/u. HTN on lisinopril, doing well. Smokes ~1 ppd since he was 18, trying to cut down, not ready to quit. No wt loss, no hemoptysis. Works in construction.

Annual exam, April 2026. 71 yo F, hx of hypothyroidism and OA. Former smoker - smoked a pack and a half a day from her 20s until she quit cold turkey when her first grandchild was born in 2005. Denies current tobacco. Active, gardens daily.
2026 wellness visit. 66-year-old gentleman, retired teacher. Never used tobacco products; wife smoked for years and he has had a lot of secondhand exposure. PMH: hyperlipidemia, BPH.
Seen 2026 for med refill. 49 y/o male with DM2 and obesity. Current smoker, 30 pack-years. Counseled on cessation; interested in varenicline.
Clinic note (2026). 77F with stage IV pancreatic cancer, liver mets, on hospice as of last month. Smoked 2 ppd x 35 yrs, still smokes a few cigarettes daily. Visit today for pain control.
Pt is a 62 yo woman presenting to establish care in 2026. Tob: quit 8 yrs ago, prior to that about half a ppd for 25 years. Etoh socially. PMH GERD, anxiety.
68 M, 2026 annual. PMH: CAD s/p PCI 2019, HTN, HLD. Social: ex-smoker, 45 pk-yr hx, quit after his MI in 2019. Walks 2 miles daily, no angina.
Date of service: 2026. 82-year-old man with mild cognitive impairment, lives with daughter. Former heavy smoker (2 ppd for 40 years), stopped in 2016. Here for flu shot.
Follow-up 2026. 55 y/o F, asthma well controlled. She smokes about 10 cigarettes a day and has since age 17. No prior LDCT.

2026 physical. 73 yo man, retired machinist, COPD GOLD 2 on tiotropium. Smoked 1 pack daily from age 16 to age 60. Remains quite functional and would be interested in treatment if anything were found.
New patient visit, 2026. 59-year-old female. Denies tobacco, alcohol or drug use. Mother had COPD. PMH: migraine, hypothyroidism.
Seen in 2026. 64 M with ESRD on HD MWF, DM2, prior BKA. Smokes 1 ppd x 40 yrs. Cardiology considers him high risk for any surgery; he states he is not interested in any operations.
2026 annual exam. 69F. Former smoker: 20 cigarettes/day for 22 years, quit 13 years ago. Hx breast cancer 2012, in remission, NED on surveillance. Exercises regularly.
Visit 2026. 51 yo M presenting with low back pain. Smoker, one pack every two days for about 30 years. PMH unremarkable.
Annual (2026): 74-year-old man, HTN and gout. Tobacco history: smoked in the army and for a few years after, roughly a pack a day for 8 years total, quit in 1978.
Seen 2026. 60 yo F with severe COPD on 3L home O2, recurrent exacerbations, prognosis discussed with palliative care - estimated less than 12 months. Former 2 ppd smoker x 40 years, quit 2021.
Pt: 80 y/o woman, very active, still drives. Smokes 1 ppd, has for 60 years. Visit year 2026. Would consider surgery if needed.
2026 visit. 65 M, new to clinic. SH: former smoker, about 1.5 ppd x 20 yrs, quit 16 years ago. Drinks 1-2 beers/night. PMH HTN.
Encounter 2026. 45-year-old female, anxiety, IBS. Smokes 1 ppd x 25 yrs.
Annual 2026. 70-year-old male. Tobacco: never. Occupational hx: coal miner x 30 years. PMH: HTN, AAA? - no, no prior imaging. Brother had AAA repair.
Visit 2026: 57 y/o F, fibromyalgia. Quit smoking in 2014 after about 30 pack-years.
Seen 2026. 72M with advanced Parkinson disease, bedbound, dysphagia, family has chosen comfort-focused care. Remote smoker 1 ppd x 50 yrs, quit 5 yrs ago.
2026 f/u: 53 yo man, HLD. Smokes a pack a day, started at 14.
Annual exam 2026. 67-year-old woman. Former smoker, quit 2009, prior 1 ppd x 30y. Osteoporosis on alendronate.
2026 visit. 76 M, AFib on apixaban, HTN. Smoked half a pack a day for 50 years; quit last year.
Pt seen 2026, 61F, RA on methotrexate. Social: she has smoked 15 cigarettes daily for the last 20 years.
Visit (2026). 68 y/o M, T2DM, CKD 3a. 40 pack-year former smoker, quit 2008. Otherwise well.
Annual 2026. 50-year-old woman, current smoker, 1 ppd since age 25. No complaints.
2026: 81 yo F, lives independently, smokes 1 ppd x 55 years. Here for knee pain.
Seen 2026. 66M with metastatic prostate cancer to bone, progressing on second-line therapy, oncology estimates survival in months. Smoker, 1.5 ppd x 45 years.
Visit 2026. 63-year-old male, HTN. Quit smoking 3 years ago; smoked about 5 cigarettes a day for 30 years before that.
2026 wellness. 75 yo man. Ex-smoker: 2 packs/day x 25 yrs, quit in 2012. Plays golf 3x/week.
Seen 2026. 58 yo F. Lifelong non-smoker. Husband smokes. PMH: HTN, prediabetes.
2026 annual. 70F. Smokes 1 ppd x 50 yrs. Clearly states she would refuse any surgery or biopsy no matter what a scan shows.
Visit 2026. 52M, GERD. Former smoker, 25 pack-years, quit 2020.
